# OmniHaskell-template

> OmniHaskell-template: maximalist Omni family member. 

Part of the WyattAu Omni template family: maximalist, monorepo-first
scaffolds sharing one gate matrix (engineering-standards).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/WyattAu/OmniHaskell-template/blob/main/README.md): quick start + make targets
- [ARCHITECTURE](https://github.com/WyattAu/$1/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): why the repo is shaped this way
- [OMNI-CORE](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/OMNI-CORE.md): the family-wide contract
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/WyattAu/$1/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): workflow rules
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/WyattAu/$1/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents
- [engineering-standards](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards): the estate gate matrix
